items.period: Shang period oracle-bone script (file description's script designation; source form identified as record 43.F356)
items.caption: A modern vector redraw of a Shang oracle-script form of 男, linked by its file description to Xiaoxuetang record 43.F356 (京津2122 / 合3457).
items.alt: Vector outline of an oracle-script glyph identified as 男.
items.selection_reason: A character-specific source record and file description identify the form and its provenance; useful as a candidate illustration of the early graph. It is a redraw, not an ancient artifact photograph, and its pixels were not inspected in this pass.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 / public domain as stated on the exact Commons file description page; source Xiaoxuetang query-interface glyph image and glyph attributes also covered by the official CC0 notice.

limitations.text: The direct Xiaoxuetang glyph-image request and Commons original media fetch both failed in the browser with cache-miss errors; the candidate is supported by the inspected descriptions and provenance, not visual inspection.
